'''Chapter 1044''' is titled "Warrior of Liberation".

==Short Summary==
[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] regains consciousness as the [[Five Elders]] reveal the [[Nika|real nature]] of his [[Gomu Gomu no Mi|Devil Fruit]].
